sourceText:
Quick & Easy Fettuccine Alfredo
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, May 24, 2011 - 5:34pm

Ingredients




1 pound of fettuccine noodles
Sauce:
1 quart of button mushrooms – sliced
6 cloves of garlic – crushed& chopped
1 bunch of scallions – sliced
1/4 pound bacon – sliced
1 tablespoon – butter
16 ounces cottage cheese
2 cups milk
1/4 cup grated Romano cheese
Dashes of red pepper flakes
Dashes of fresh ground black pepper
Dashes of sea salt
Dashes of nutmeg
Olive oil for drizzling

Preparation

1 Heat a griddle and place the bacon on the griddle to get crisp. 2 Prepare the noodles as directed. 3 Heat a large frying pan with the tablespoon of butter and a drizzle of olive oil. Place in heated frying pan the sliced mushrooms, garlic and scallions to sauté on medium. Add the dashes of salt, black pepper and red pepper flakes 4 In a food processor place the cottage cheese with a dash of nutmeg. Process the cottage cheese until smooth. 5 Add the milk to the sautéing mushrooms and scallions and let simmer on low. Add the cottage cheese and stir. Add the grated Romano cheese, bacon pieces and add the noodles. Toss until everything is combined well. 6 Plate the Fettuccine Alfredo and top with some extra grating cheese.

About


This is easy, delicious and satisfying.
Enjoy with Love,
Catherine
